title: Save the Evidence
about: Screenshot first, then block, report and tell someone you trust.

cards.situation: In your group chat, someone keeps posting mean things about you.

image.alt: Your phone shows the group chat Weekend Crew. shadow_77: just leave the chat. kai_m: lol. shadow_77: nobody wants you here. Under the phone: It's never your fault.

cards.prompt: This is the chat. **Tap each part** to see what it is.

parts.job: Tells the app, so it can remove it.

cards.explanation: Who, what and when: keep those, and you have proof.

cards.prompt: You tap Block before saving anything. **What happens to the messages?**

image.alt: The Weekend Crew chat. A finger presses the Block button at the top. Below, shadow_77's messages: just leave the chat, and nobody wants you here.
image.revealAlt: The chat is empty. One grey line: You blocked shadow_77. No messages are left.

options.text: They may vanish, leaving nothing to show
The app keeps a copy for you

cards.explanation: On this app, blocking hid the whole chat, and the proof went with it.

cards.title: Screenshot first
cards.body:
Before you block, **save the evidence**: screenshot the messages, the username and the date. Then block, report it in the app, and tell a trusted adult.

A threat to share a private picture, even a fake one? Report it to **eSafety** too, and if you're under 18, to the **ACCCE**.

image.alt: The same chat, labelled. A dashed frame around the username, the time and the message, marked 1, Screenshot. The Block button is marked 2, and the Report button 3.

cards.prompt: shadow_77 posts again: "everyone's laughing at you". **Tap what you do first.**

image.alt: The Weekend Crew chat. Under nobody wants you here, a new message from shadow_77: everyone's laughing at you.
image.revealAlt: A small screenshot of the chat, marked Saved, and a trusted adult beside it saying: Thanks for showing me.

options.text: Screenshot it, then tell a trusted adult
Reply with something just as mean
options.nudge: Which choice keeps proof of what they said?

options.text: Delete the chat so I don't see it
options.nudge: Which choice keeps proof of what they said?

cards.explanation: Yes: now you have the evidence, and someone on your side.
cards.showAnswer: Screenshot it, then tell a trusted adult: replying can make it worse, and deleting loses the evidence.

cards.prompt: A new account says it made a fake private picture of you, and wants money. **Tap what you save.**

image.alt: A new chat from unknown_acc, with a grey picture. A grey box with a crossed-out eye reads Picture hidden. Then the message: Pay $50 or I share it. Under the phone: It's never your fault.

options.text: The messages and their profile, not the picture
The picture too, as extra proof
options.nudge: What shows who did this, without keeping the picture?

options.text: Nothing: I'll pay, so it never gets shared
options.nudge: Paying usually leads to more demands. What shows who did this?

cards.explanation: Right: save who they are and what they said, never the picture itself.
cards.showAnswer: Screenshot the messages and their profile, never the picture. And never pay: paying usually leads to more demands.

cards.prompt: You're 14, and you've shown a trusted adult the threat. **Tap where you report it.**

image.alt: You show your phone to a trusted adult. On it: unknown_acc, Picture hidden, Pay $50 or I share it. The adult says: We'll report it together.

options.text: The app, eSafety and the ACCCE
Only the app: it's just a fake
options.nudge: A fake is still serious. Who helps under-18s who are being threatened?

options.text: Nobody: I might get in trouble
options.nudge: You won't be in trouble for asking for help. Who helps when a picture is used to threaten someone?

cards.explanation: Yes: eSafety can help remove it, and the ACCCE helps under-18s being threatened.
cards.showAnswer: Report it to the app, eSafety and the ACCCE. You will not be in trouble for asking for help.

cards.title: Recap
cards.body:
Screenshot first, then block, report and tell a trusted adult. It's never your fault.

**Talk any time:** **Kids Helpline** 1800 55 1800 (ages 5 to 25) or **Lifeline** 13 11 14.

**Try this:** Practise taking a screenshot on your phone, so you can do it fast.

**Next:** Who to tell, and where to go, whatever goes wrong online.
